votes.motion: Approve the Police Chief's request to appoint Robert V. Taylor as a Reserve Officer in Lunenburg.
votes.quote: mr. sund seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Approve the Boot Drive for the LHS Field Hockey Booster Club on 10/6/12.
votes.quote: mr. sund moved to approve the boot drive for the lhs field hockey booster club on 10/6/12. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of the change of location of the liquor license of Asian Imperial d/b/a Asian Imperial Garden from 324 Electric Ave to 5 Electric Ave., effective January 1, 2013.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to recommend the approval of the change of location of the liquor license of asian imperial d/b/a asian imperial garden from 324 electric ave to 5 electric ave.

votes.motion: Approve the Pedlar's License for Scott Lowe d/b/a Scott's Doggs as the application provides for location and hours of operation.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that the board approve the pedlar's license for scott lowe d/b/a scott's doggs as the application provides for location and hours of operation.

votes.motion: Accept the donation of used metal shelving units and related materials from Dave MacDonald, as described by the Town Manager.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo motioned to accept the donation as described by the town manager. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.
mr. debettencourt moved to adjourn the meeting. mr. sund seconded. the board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 7:43pm.
